载员同样计入编组数量和COST；选择单位后点击添加。: Passengers count towards army size and COST. Select a unit, then add it.
加入编组后可配置预先搭载单位。: Add this carrier to your army to configure its passengers.
该单位不能预先搭载至此格纳库: This unit cannot preload into this hangar
预先搭载会先将这艘运输单位加入编组。: Preloading first adds this carrier to your army.
选择格纳库会将该单位加入编组并预先搭载。: Choosing a hangar adds this unit to your army and preloads it.
没有兼容且有剩余容量的格纳库。: No compatible hangar has enough free capacity.
可在格纳库间调整，或选择独立部署。: Transfer between hangars or choose independent deployment.
搭载中每次己方回合恢复25%耐久、50% EN，并随机修复两个受损零件。: Embarked units recover 25% HP and 50% EN and repair two random damaged parts at the start of each allied turn.
部位完好时消耗1 AP切换飞行姿态；起飞后作为航空单位，可跨越山岩与水域，不消耗: Spend 1 AP to switch flight stance with all parts intact. Airborne units cross mountains and water without spending their movement action. Landing requires valid terrain.
房间名称需为1–20位中文、英文字母、数字、下划线或短横线: Room names must contain 1–20 Chinese characters, English letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
搭载结束本次行动，下次己方回合可出击；出击范围使用载员自身移动力。: Boarding ends this action. Launch from your next turn using the passenger’s movement range.
出击视为已移动，仍可攻击或使用技能；剩余行动点×75%并向上取整，所属舰船不能撤: Launching counts as movement but allows attacks and skills. Remaining AP becomes 75%, rounded up; the carrier cannot undo movement.
搭载中每次己方回合恢复25%最大耐久、50%最大EN，并随机修复最多两个受损零件: Each friendly turn, cargo recovers 25% maximum HP and 50% maximum EN, and repairs up to two random damaged parts.
舰毁紧急退出损失25%最大耐久和最大盾牌；无合法落点或耐久归零则损失载员。: Emergency evacuation costs 25% maximum HP and shield. Cargo is lost if no valid exit exists or HP reaches zero.
重连超时，已离开房间: reconnect timed out; left the room
粘贴他人的分享代码后加载，或生成当前编组的分享代码并复制。: Paste another player's share code to load it, or generate and copy a code for the current formation.
编组分享代码无效。: The formation share code is invalid.
分享代码已生成，请手动复制。: Share code generated. Copy it manually.
隐藏玩家设置的单位昵称；战斗 LOG 仍保留昵称。: Hide player-assigned unit names; battle logs still keep them.
